mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_question_stat (member_id, question_id, weight, correct_count, wrong_count, last_answered_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{questionId}, GREATEST(1 + #{weightDelta}, 1), #{correctInc}, #{wrongInc}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weight = GREATEST(weight + #{weightDelta}, 1), correct_count = correct_count + #{correctInc}, wrong_count = wrong_count + #{wrongInc}, last_answered_at = NOW()
